hero.title: The next chapter
hero.copy: Help us rebuild Cryptomine Space X and bring our blockchain gaming ecosystem into its next era.
hero.note: An independent project. A community-driven mission. A universe still waiting to be explored.

mission.title: We built a universe.
mission.copy: Cryptomine Space X is an independent blockchain gaming project returning to the spirit of early Play-to-Earn: virtual economies, collectible assets and communities built around a game. We are upgrading the experience honestly, one system at a time.
items: Built by a small team with a long-term commitment to the universe.
Players and supporters help shape what gets built next.
Frontend, infrastructure, documentation and gameplay remain in focus.
Solana is a development goal, not a completed migration or promise.

ecosystem.title: Current systems.
ecosystem.copy: Visit the existing interfaces and follow the work toward the next chapter. Nothing here pretends to be further along than it is.
cards: Enter the battlefield, explore the game and discover the current state of our universe.
Visit the farming interface and explore the existing ecosystem.
We are exploring the technical path toward a possible Solana expansion, subject to development, testing and security review.

support.title: Every step forward
support.copy: Community participation can help us improve the game, modernize the infrastructure and explore new blockchain integrations. These are objectives, not committed percentages or available funds.
items: Frontend, gameplay, new features and player experience.
Hosting, development tools, technical services and maintenance.
Testing, contract review, documentation and Solana analysis.
Content, pilot tournaments, promotion and community growth.

token.title: Support the project.
token.copy: We are using a community-oriented token initiative to support awareness and potentially contribute to future development funding. Token trading is voluntary and separate from access to the game.
risks: A possible initial team purchase of USD 10 is not a significant investment and does not guarantee success.
Token price may rise or fall considerably. No profits, refunds, rewards or revenue share are guaranteed.
Buying the token is not required to play. Development funding depends on funds actually received.
Do not treat this initiative as financial advice or a promise of future value.

transparency.title: Show the work.
transparency.copy: Funding figures will be published when verified records become available. This panel is ready for documented updates.

roadmap.title: No shortcuts.
roadmap.copy: Every phase is a work objective. Statuses stay planned until there is clear evidence to say otherwise.
